feat(chatbot): Save checklist to local CSV file
commitResults.messageBody:
The CSV file will have 5 columns: "tag", "mark", "content", "start", "end"
- "tag" is used to identify task subclass
- "mark" and "content" corresponds to the respective task attributes
- "start" corresponds to EventItem's "from" attribute
- "end" corresponds to DeadlineItem's "by" and EventItem's "to" attributes

commitResults.messageBody:
Chatbot functions are separated from main program loop and moved to convenient API-esque methods.
All functionalities are moved to separate instance, static instance is reserved for main program.
Soft error handling and printing is consolidated into chatbot methods, all other methods now throw exceptions.
New commands: save, search, delete matching, mark matching, unmark matching
Command flags are now associated with code enums
